supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not show a PowerShell process launch or PowerShell command around the reported 13:40 UTC window.
At 13:44 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 used the proxy to download about 38.8 MB from download.windowsupdate.com with a Windows Update Agent user agent, consistent with Windows Update activity.

At 14:11 UTC, maria.lopez's session launched GoogleDriveFS.exe from Google Drive File Stream, and the proxy recorded a Google Update connection. Google Drive is not among the software and services identified as approved in the provided environment context.
At 13:57 UTC, FILE-HD-01 resolved WS-MLOPEZ-01 and initiated a connection to its TCP port 135; the record does not establish the purpose or outcome of that RPC connection.
The workstation generated Kerberos and LDAP activity to DC-HD-01 using its computer account during the review period; the available records do not identify this as malicious.

The evidence supports investigating the unapproved Google Drive software and the FILE-HD-01-to-workstation RPC connection, but does not establish that either is related to the reported PowerShell window or is malicious.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records contain no PowerShell process-creation, command-line, script-block, or module logging evidence for the reported window; this does not establish that PowerShell did not run.
The FILE-HD-01 connection record provides endpoint and connection-state information but no RPC operation, initiating process, or confirmed activity on WS-MLOPEZ-01.
The Google Drive records show its process launch and a Google Update connection, but do not show file synchronization, uploads, or the contents or destination of any transferred files.
claims_not_established: Whether a PowerShell window appeared at approximately 13:40 UTC, and, if so, which process launched it, what command it ran, or who initiated it.
Whether the Google Drive installation or launch was authorized, and whether it transferred organizational data.
Whether the FILE-HD-01 RPC connection was expected, what it did, or whether it was related to the reported alert.
Whether the LSASS handle-access events or later WMI-related process events were connected to the reported PowerShell activity.
additional_evidence_needed: WS-MLOPEZ-01 process-creation and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including process ancestry and command lines.
Endpoint investigation of Google Drive File Stream: installation history, binary and signer validation, user authorization, sync configuration, and file-transfer history.
FILE-HD-01 and WS-MLOPEZ-01 RPC/WMI telemetry around 13:57 UTC, including initiating process, RPC method or operation, and any corresponding endpoint events.
Service and process identification for the svchost.exe instance accessing LSASS, plus nearby endpoint security alerts or memory-access telemetry.
